content.value_statement: Important decisions and guidance often remain buried in conversations. This skill turns them into structured, linked Notion pages for reliable reuse.
actual_capabilities: Classifies source material as a decision, how-to, FAQ, wiki entry, learning note, or documentation page.
Searches and fetches existing Notion pages before choosing whether to create or update content.
Extracts facts, actions, rationale, alternatives, outcomes, prerequisites, links, and edge cases from supplied material.
Creates structured Notion pages with summaries, source links, tags, owners, dates, statuses, and relations.
Adds backlinks and related tasks when the source material identifies follow-up work.
limitations: Requires a configured Notion MCP connection and completed OAuth login.
Depends on the user having access to the target workspace and database.
Referenced template and example directories are not included in this package.
Does not verify factual accuracy beyond supplied material and accessible Notion pages.

use_cases.title: Record Technical Decisions
use_cases.description: Convert architecture discussions into decision records with alternatives, rationale, outcomes, owners, and related specifications.

use_cases.title: Build Support Guidance
use_cases.description: Turn recurring questions and operational notes into concise FAQs or step-by-step procedures.

use_cases.title: Maintain a Connected Wiki
use_cases.description: Update existing knowledge pages, add relations, and preserve source links for future readers.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these notes into a Notion FAQ for [audience]. Ask me to choose the database before creating the page: [notes]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a first capture from short notes.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture this decision in Notion. Include context, alternatives, rationale, outcome, owner, and related pages: [conversation]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this after a meeting or design discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Update Existing Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Notion for pages about [topic]. Update the best match with these new steps, edge cases, and source links: [material]
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to maintain an authoritative how-to or documentation page.

prompt_templates.title: Create Linked Knowledge
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a linked knowledge set from [conversation]. Produce a decision record, one how-to, related tasks, and backlinks after confirming each destination.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for complex conversations containing decisions, procedures, and follow-up work.

output_examples.input: Capture our discussion about selecting PostgreSQL for the reporting service.
output: Decision: Adopt PostgreSQL for the reporting service.
Context: The team needs reliable joins, mature tooling, and predictable operational support.
Alternatives: MySQL and a document database were considered.
Next step: The platform owner will publish the migration plan.

output_examples.input: Turn these onboarding questions into a support FAQ.
output: How do I request access? Submit the workspace access form and select your team.
When is access approved? The workspace owner reviews requests each business day.
Where can I get help? Contact the support channel linked from the onboarding hub.

best_practices: Confirm the audience, page type, destination, owner, and visibility before creating or updating content.
Search Notion first to avoid duplicate pages and preserve established links.
Keep source links, rationale, dates, and related records so readers can verify context.
anti_patterns: Do not publish sensitive conversations without checking access permissions and intended visibility.
Do not create a new page when an existing authoritative page should be updated.
Do not assign owners, statuses, or outcomes that are unsupported by the source material.

faq.question: What content can this skill capture?
faq.answer: It supports decisions, how-to guides, FAQs, wiki entries, learning notes, and documentation pages.

faq.question: Does it require a Notion connection?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure the Notion MCP server and complete OAuth login before using Notion tools.

faq.question: Can it update an existing page?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search for relevant pages, fetch the best match, and update that page.

faq.question: How does it choose a database?
faq.answer: It reviews the content type and required properties. It should ask you when multiple destinations are suitable.

faq.question: Are the referenced templates included?
faq.answer: No. This package contains only the skill instructions, so referenced template and example files are unavailable.

faq.question: Can it create follow-up tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create linked tasks when follow-up work exists and the relevant database is accessible.
